authority: User explicitly requested option2: explore other datasets to find conditional component benefit; all attempted outcomes retained.

host_gpu_gate.load_policy: Only prospectively sealed exact desktop identities may coexist. Unknown/new/Python/WSL GPU contexts are rejected. No utilization ceiling: this component screen is not a performance benchmark.

hypotheses.TIME_ONLY: Removing the channel branch worsens forecasting in some multivariate conditions.
hypotheses.A5_LAG0: Removing extra decoder lags, while retaining lag0 and last-context addition, worsens forecasting.
hypotheses.E_FIXED: Freezing stage-local PCA E, while P/D remain trainable, worsens forecasting.

design.baseline: Fresh OURS for every matched seed; no historical baseline prediction reuse.
design.contrasts: Three ablations versus same-seed OURS; positive ablation-minus-OURS MSE supports the component in this condition.
design.time_only: Remove channel residual branch only; retain temporal branch and shared joint LayerNorm. Not a channel-independent whole model.
design.E_fixed: Same initial state; E excluded from actual optimizer, checked unchanged within search and within fresh A60 refit separately.
design.lag0: Keep direct last-context addition; use only lag0 decoder features.
design.scope: Conditional implementation-level effects; capacity/optimization differences are part of these interventions.

selection.datasets: Available safe-prefix traffic and air-quality domains beyond earlier Jena/Appliances/ETT; chosen with historical results known.
selection.pems32: Fixed32 sensors chosen by sensor-ID SHA ordering; derived from PEMS08, not an independent second dataset.
selection.K: Inherited fixed K8/K6 to isolate components, not a test of K-tau optimality.
selection.caps: PeMS6 prospectively because prior Full hit3 and6; Beijing3. Same cap within each dataset; no outcome-based extensions.
selection.alternatives: ETTm1 is slower and related to ETTh1; solar137 is heavier; synthetic phase-shift stress tests could diagnose mechanisms but do not answer current real-data scope.

training.selection: Minimum A_stop MSE, earlier exact tie; seal before fresh A60 refit and V evaluation.

controller_policy.admission: Whole remaining4-arm group must fit. After first OURS success use maximum successful job walltime times1.35 with fixed floors. Time only, never V.
controller_policy.partial: If time prediction changes, unfinished jobs markedNOT_RUN_BUDGET. Incomplete optional4-arm seed not included in primary cohort.
controller_policy.retry: One identical-setting technical retry; scientific gate failure stops.
controller_policy.locking: Shared controller/worker locks and identity-verified live parent lease; no concurrent GPU experiments.

analysis.primary_cohort: All4arms complete on both base seeds; add92603 only when all4arms complete. Show any partial results separately.
analysis.summaries: All seed points, paired differences, median/Q1/Q3, direction count and relative median change.
analysis.descriptive_rule: Absolute difference of medians must exceed maximum arm IQR, with at least ceil(2*n/3) paired seeds in same direction; otherwise UNCLEAR. Not a significance test.
analysis.provisional: n2 always PILOT. If either arm selects its cap in at least ceil(2*n/3) seeds, UNDERTRAINED_PROVISIONAL. n3 remains exploratory.
analysis.reporting: Publish every dataset, intervention, failed attempt, budget exclusion and null/negative outcome. No universal necessity, equivalence or final-test claim.
analysis.forbidden: No protectedT numeric reads, no winner-only reporting, no outcome-based seed/cap/dataset additions within this campaign.

literature.title: TSMixer
literature.role: Time/feature mixing motivates component comparison; does not guarantee benefit.

literature.title: PatchTST
literature.role: Channel-independent successes motivate testing rather than assuming mixing necessity.

literature.title: DCRNN
literature.role: Traffic spatial-temporal dependency motivates traffic domain; our model does not use its graph.
